newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian PM sees no more obstacles for Bakun dam.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian PM sees no more obstacles for Bakun dam.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad does not foresee any more obstacles to completing the giant Bakun hydroelectric dam, The Star newspaper reported on Tuesday.
"Works can carry on...there will be no more obstacles," The Star quoted him as saying.
Mahathir's comments came after he attended a festival in the eastern Malaysian state of Sarawak on Borneo island, where the 2,400-megawatt capacity dam is being built.

On Monday, an Appeals Court ruled in favour of Ekran Bhd, the developer of the 13.6-billion-ringgit ($5.5 billion) dam. Three tribals affected by the project had sued to stop the dam on environmental grounds, but the court ruled against them. -- Kuala Lumpur newsroom (603-201 4813)
